Chat request with response_format json_schema that validates the output structure

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::BatchClient;
use liter_llm::FileClient;
use liter_llm::LlmClient;
use liter_llm::ResponseClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"messages":[{"content":"What is the temperature in Paris today?","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4","response_format":{"json_schema":{"name":"weather","schema":{"properties":{"temp":{"type":"number"}},"required":["temp"],"type":"object"}},"type":"json_schema"}}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.chat(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.choices);
    println!("{:?}", result.choices[0].message.content);
    println!("{:?}", result.choices[0].finish_reason);
}
```
